definitions.explanation: A small room measuring four and a half tatami mats (about 7.3 square meters), a classic size for a modest Japanese room.

examples.japanese: {学生時代|がくせいじだい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四畳半|よじょうはん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいた→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: In my student days I lived in a four-and-a-half-mat room.

examples.japanese: {四畳半|よじょうはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧。
examples.english: A four-and-a-half-mat room is smaller than you'd expect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}ながら→昔ながら：26817_mukashinagara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{四畳半|よじょうはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下宿|げしゅく}→下宿：01399_geshuku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I spent my youth in an old-fashioned four-and-a-half-mat lodging.

notes:
A room measuring four and a half ⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧ (tatami mats), about 7.3 square meters. A classic size for a small, modest room.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四畳半|よじょうはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: a four-and-a-half-mat room
- {四畳半|よじょうはん}{一間|ひとま}: a single small room

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {四畳半|よじょうはん} evokes nostalgic, sometimes romanticized images of frugal student or single life and appears often in literature and film.
